reason: I already pay my agency to handle Instagram, and my counter boy has no time to type PINs for coupons during the morning rush. Rs 200 a month doesn't cover the hassle, and I'd rather not start leaning on a beta app run by a small team.
objection: It's free now, but once my customers and creators are coming through it, you'll start charging, or the small team will shut it down and I'm left with nothing.
would_change_my_mind: My agency running it for me, or a café owner I know showing me real walk-ins and cost per customer from it, plus it being written down that the business side stays free.
